changed: Off goldens (notes and ERP) record each event's payload key set, recorded before any change and byte-identical after. Shadow mode: start_run/admit_run take an optional task_kind (the CLI passes its preset kind; API runs pass none); a resolved shadow run records task_id/task_version; an unresolved one records ir.shadow_failed IR_TASK_UNRESOLVED once in the creating batch. After today's validation of a write proposal, a resolved run compiles a 1-step plan, validates it, digests it and records ir.plan_compiled (plan id, digest, step count, definition id/version, digest_matches) with step records in one put_plan batch; compile/validate failures record ir.shadow_failed with a fixed stage message in the wait_for_approval batch. The Coordinator refuses execution_ir=on until 2c.6.
open_items: 2c.6 removes the Coordinator's refusal of execution_ir=on.
Optional (review R-5): a test that an idempotent replay writes no second unresolved event; docstring that the gone-definition branch applies per proposal.
Codex batch review of 2c.2-2c.5 before 2c.6 dispatches.
Postgres shadow and store tests: 79 passed on 423db64, run by the controller outside the gate (HP-6); replay suite 10 passed.

rulings.ruling: An unresolved shadow run records IR_TASK_UNRESOLVED once at admission (fixes the code to match ADRs 0027/0028).
Compile/validate shadow runs only on validated write proposals of a resolved run; answers have no approval digest to compare.
Shadow IR-stage errors become ir.shadow_failed; store errors propagate.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: A shadow store failure fails a run off would finish.

rulings.ruling: execution_ir=on is refused at Coordinator construction until 2c.6 (every selectable mode must be complete).
rulings.cost_if_wrong: A profile selecting on fails at startup for one task.

rulings.ruling: Codex hit its usage limit; a Claude reviewer (opus, fresh context) reviewed instead, with a Codex batch pass queued.
